about.hero.lede: The public health network of {{sitio.city}}, easier to find and use.
about.meta.description: {{sitio.city}} Turnos brings together the appointments, services and hours of the public health network. Built on the Human Rounds platform.
about.meta.title: About {{sitio.city}} Turnos | {{sitio.brand}}
about.platform.detail_text: The code is being prepared for release under the AGPL license, so other communities can review it, improve it and adapt it.
about.platform.p: {{sitio.city}} Turnos is built on Human Rounds, a platform created so municipalities and health networks can publish their services and manage appointment requests with a simple experience.
about.platform.title: Built on Human Rounds
about.section1.intro: {{sitio.city}} Turnos brings together the services of {{sitio.network_long}} so you know what care is available, where, and how to get it.
about.section1.item_care_text: walk-in in order of arrival, or with a request and a medical referral.
about.section1.item_hours_text: the practical information before you leave the house.
about.section1.item_services_text: specialties, imaging, laboratory, vaccination, dentistry, groups and workshops.
about.section1.title: Clear information, in one place
about.section2.p1: Built by neighbors of {{sitio.city}}, not for profit. It's free, has no ads, and doesn't sell anything.
about.section2.p2: It started from a conversation with hospital doctors so anyone could check the board and manage their appointment from their phone.
about.section2.title: A neighbors' project
about.trust.p: We only use your data to manage your request and so the hospital can treat you. We never use it for advertising, analytics or market research.
about.trust.title: Your data is used to treat you
